policy.anti_piracy: No scraping of copyrighted commercial streaming services (YouTube, Spotify, etc.). No illegal bulk audio downloading.
policy.provenance_enforced: All audio must have documented Creative Commons or Public Domain licensing with explicit provenance.
policy.modality_masking: Tracks without verified audio have audio_available=False with explicit modality masking, never zero-padding or fake embeddings.

sources.commercial_restriction: Non-commercial for NC tracks; commercial permitted for CC BY / CC0 tracks

sources.mapping_identifiers: FMA track_id, artist_name, track_title, cross-referenceable to MusicBrainz by normalized artist + title
